text: The pasta carbonara was rich and creamy, with crispy pancetta. Server Marco was attentive and refilled our waters regularly. Moderate prices for downtown.
Ordered the signature burger medium-rare. It came out well-done and dry. Fries were lukewarm. Disappointed considering the high ratings.
Solid coffee shop. Good cold brew and flaky almond croissants. Ample seating with power outlets. A bit noisy during lunchtime rush.
Wait time was over 45 minutes on a Tuesday evening despite reservations. Food was okay once seated, but host service was unorganized.
Fresh sushi and sashimi platters. Salmon melted in your mouth. Wasabi was pungent and authentic. Would definitely dine here again.
Greasy pizza with soggy crust. The delivery took an hour and a half and the box arrived crushed. Will not order again.
Nice neighborhood bakery. Sourdough loaf has a crunchy crust and chewy crumb. Friendly staff who remember regular customers.
Tacos were flavorful, especially the al pastor with grilled pineapple. Salsa bar had 6 distinct varieties from mild to habanero.
